lemmas.primary_translation: according to someone's wish or preference / for someone or something / because of

definitions.translation: according to someone's wish or preference (lit. for someone's part)

examples.no: for min del vil jeg si meg enig
examples.en: for my part, I would say that I agree

examples.no: direktøren synes for sin del at det var en god idé
examples.en: the director, for his part, thinks that it was a good idea

examples.no: for hans del passer det bra
examples.en: as far as he is concerned, it suits him well

examples.no: sesongen var over for hans del
examples.en: the season was over for him

examples.no: det blir for dyrt for vår del
examples.en: it will be too expensive for us

examples.no: vi gjør ikke dette for pengenes del
examples.en: we are not doing this for the sake of money
